sst.config_screen.title: Simply Swords Tweaks Configuration
sst.config_screen.op_required: §4§lWarning:§f §cYou must be a server operator to edit this.§f
sst.category.battle_standards.desc: Tweaks, effect multipliers, and range configurations for §6Battle Standard§f entities.
sst.option.banner_healing_allowed.desc:
Allows §6Battle Standard§f entities to receive healing from any source.

If disabled, standards cannot be healed at all.
sst.option.galeforce_haste_amplifier.des: The §6Haste§f status effect amplifier granted to the owner while near §6Galeforce§f.
sst.option.galeforce_haste_radius.desc: Radius in blocks around §6Galeforce§f in which the owner receives the §6Haste§f effect.
sst.option.galeforce_aoe_radius.desc: Radius in blocks around §6Galeforce§f for pulling nearby enemies and applying aura effects.
sst.option.galeforce_pain_amplifier.desc: The §6Pain§f status effect amplifier applied to targets caught within §6Galeforce's§f vortex.
sst.option.abyssal_standard_haste_amplif: The §6Haste§f status effect amplifier granted to the owner while near §6Abyssal Standard§f.
sst.option.abyssal_standard_haste_radius: Radius in blocks around §6Abyssal Standard§f in which the owner receives the §6Haste§f effect.
sst.option.abyssal_standard_aoe_radius.d: Radius in blocks around §6Abyssal Standard§f for team buffs, aura damage and negative effects for enemies.
sst.option.abyssal_standard_aoe_haste_am: The §6Haste§f status effect amplifier granted to nearby allies within range.
sst.option.abyssal_standard_aoe_slowness: The §6Slowness§f status effect amplifier applied to enemies within range.
sst.option.sunfire_aoe_radius.desc: Radius in blocks around §6Sunfire§f for team Strength, healing and aura damage.
sst.option.sunfire_strength_amplifier.de: The §6Strength§f status effect amplifier granted to nearby allies within range.
sst.option.nullification_aoe_radius.desc: Radius in blocks around §6Nullification Standard§f for removing buffs from enemies and debuffs from allies.
sst.option.nullification_prevent_battle_:
Prevents the Battle Fatigue harmful status effect from being applied to the caster when summoning a  §6Nullification Standard§f.

Enables an internal cooldown system instead, preventing players from resetting the cooldown by drinking milk or using cleansing effects.
sst.option.nullification_cooldown.desc:
Cooldown duration in seconds before §6Nullification Standard§f can be summoned again.

Only active when §6Prevent Battle Fatigue§f is enabled.
sst.category.bug_fixes.desc: Fixes for various bugs in §6Simply Swords§f.
sst.option.fix_status_effect_stacking.de: Fixes the effect stacking bug where a battle standard maintains a higher amplifier than configured if granted by an external source (e.g. §6Enigma§f retaining §6Twisted Blade's§f Haste XV while near §6Galeforce§f).
sst.option.fix_elemental_vortex_leak.des: Fixes §6Galeforce§f attacking its owner while under the effect of the §6Elemental Vortex§f status effect.
sst.option.icewhisper_slowness_cap.desc:
Caps the maximum §6Slowness§f debuff amplifier that §6Icewhisper§f can stack onto targets.

Fixes Simply Swords' bug where Slowness can stack infinitely.

§6-1§f: Disables fix (retains infinite stacking)
sst.category.compatibility.desc: Integrations and balancing with other mods.
sst.option.rebalance_compat_enabled.desc: Applies §6ReBalance§f's PvP damage multiplier and global reduction threshold to §6Battle Standard§f aura damage dealt to players.
